speaker: SPEAKER_04
transcript: There is no battle on Earth or in space which is more important than the battle which you have undertaken nor is there any struggle, large as this may be, that offers such an immediate promise of success. No Congress that Washington has seen in recent years is, I believe, more important than this. I know that this conference will not consist merely of orations, but will represent, in two weeks, a solid determination to make a dent on this problem which will give us promise in our lifetime of making sure that all people In the world, have an opportunity to eat. To that task, I can assure you the United States of America is committed.

explicit_propositions.text: The battle the listener has undertaken is the most important battle on Earth or in space.
This conference will not consist solely of speeches.
No other struggle, regardless of scale, promises success as immediately as this one.
This particular Congress is more important than any recent Congress in Washington.
The conference will demonstrate a firm commitment over two weeks to address the issue at hand.
The efforts during the conference will result in tangible progress toward solving global hunger.
Such progress could lead to ensuring everyone in the world has access to food within the lifetimes of those present.

assumptions.text: The speaker represents a legitimate and authoritative voice of the United States government.
The audience believes that addressing global hunger is morally urgent and worthy of national priority.
Success in this endeavor is measurable and achievable within a finite timeframe.
The speaker’s credibility is sufficient to inspire trust in their assurance of U.S. commitment.
The participants view themselves as agents capable of enacting meaningful change.
Global hunger is a solvable systemic problem rather than an inevitable condition.
Two weeks of focused effort can produce significant, lasting impact.
The audience values concrete outcomes over symbolic gestures.
There exists shared understanding between the speaker and audience regarding the definition of 'opportunity to eat'.
The international community recognizes the importance of collective action on food security.
